observations: The stated simulated population mixes 30% random guesses, 40% near 33 and 30% near 22; I predicted About 23 rather than equilibrium zero.
Set my guess to zero, showed the crowd and marked zero. The graph showed average 34.3 and target 22.9.
After showing the crowd, the guess slider was disabled, preventing a second guess against the same crowd.
Reveal accurately said zero missed by 22.9 and 84 simulated guesses were closer; it explicitly distinguished this generated population from real players.
